text: Which Power Platform product is primarily used to build custom business applications with little to no code?
explanation: Power Apps is the low-code app development product in Power Platform, used to build canvas and model-driven business apps.

text: Which TWO of the following are core Power Platform products? (Select all that apply)
explanation: The core Power Platform products are Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power Pages/Power Virtual Agents. Excel and Teams are Microsoft 365 tools, not Power Platform products.

text: Dataverse can only be used by Power Apps, not by Power Automate or Power BI.
explanation: Dataverse is a shared data platform used across Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Virtual Agents, not exclusive to any single product.

text: Which type of Power Apps app is built starting from a blank canvas and a pixel-perfect layout?
explanation: Canvas apps start from a blank canvas, giving full control over layout and design. Model-driven apps are generated automatically from your data model.

text: Put these steps for building a basic canvas app in the correct order.
explanation: You start a blank app, connect the data it will use, build out the screens/controls, then publish and share it with users.

text: What is the term for the event that starts a Power Automate cloud flow?
explanation: A trigger is the event that starts a flow, such as a new item being created or a scheduled time being reached. Actions are the steps that run after the trigger fires.

text: Which type of Power Automate flow runs automatically on a set schedule, such as every day at 9 AM?
explanation: A scheduled cloud flow runs on a recurrence you define, like daily or weekly, rather than in response to an event or a manual trigger.

text: Which Power BI component is used to author reports with visuals, and is installed on your desktop?
explanation: Power BI Desktop is the free Windows application used to connect to data, build models, and author reports before publishing them to the Power BI Service.

text: Which TWO of these are valid ways to visualize data in a Power BI report? (Select all that apply)
explanation: Bar charts and card visuals are report visuals. A SQL query is a way to retrieve data, and a data gateway connects on-premises data to the cloud — neither is a visual.

text: What is the primary purpose of Power Virtual Agents (now part of Copilot Studio)?

options.text: Building conversational chatbots without writing code

explanation: Power Virtual Agents / Copilot Studio lets you build chatbots using a guided, no-code graphical interface to define topics and conversation flow.

text: Environments in Power Platform are used to separate apps, flows, and data for different purposes, such as development versus production.
explanation: Environments act as containers to separate apps and data by purpose or audience, such as separating development, testing, and production.

text: Which Power Platform feature lets administrators control which connectors can be used together in a single app or flow?
explanation: Data loss prevention (DLP) policies classify connectors into groups (e.g., business vs. non-business) and control which can be combined, to prevent unsafe data mixing.
